skill.name: dedupe-merge
skill.description: Merges several prospect or contact lists into one clean list, resolving duplicates by person and by company. Matches on email, profile URL and name plus domain, then uses enrich_person only on ambiguous rows to confirm current role and company. Use when someone says merge these lists, dedupe my CSVs, combine event and CRM exports, or remove duplicates before sending.
skill.summary: Merge contact lists, preserve each record's source, and review uncertain matches.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The Leadsets endpoint receives contact data when enrichment runs, and the workflow enables enrichment by default without explicit approval. Spreadsheet exports may also interpret untrusted contact values as formulas. No evidence found of shell execution, environment access, system reconnaissance, or an attempt to override the audit.

remediation.issue: The workflow sends ambiguous contacts to Leadsets by default.
remediation.suggestion: Default to local matching. Before any enrichment call, disclose the destination, fields, and row count, request explicit approval, and send only the identifiers needed.

remediation.issue: Contact values can reach spreadsheet outputs without documented formula safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Write imported text as literal values in sheet tools and neutralize formula-like values when exporting CSV. Test the merged, company, and review outputs.

content.value_statement: Contact exports often contain duplicate people and conflicting details. Merge lists into one record per person, preserve source names, and flag matches that need review.
actual_capabilities: Maps columns from CSV files, sheet tabs, or CRM exports to a common format.
Matches people by work email, profile URL, or normalized name and company domain.
Groups companies by root domain and reports the number of contacts per company.
Preserves source labels and conflicting values in the merged output.
Uses Leadsets enrichment to check current roles and employers for ambiguous contacts.
Separates unresolved matches for review and reports how many rows were merged.
limitations: Does not verify existing email addresses as a separate step. Input addresses that were not checked remain marked unchecked.
Does not search for new contacts or fill gaps outside ambiguous rows.
Does not delete or overwrite existing CRM records.
Enrichment requires a Leadsets account and runs by default. It is subject to account limits and a default cap of 200 rows.

use_cases.title: Reconcile event signups with CRM contacts
use_cases.description: Combine event registrations with a CRM export and identify duplicate contacts before preparing a follow-up list.

use_cases.title: Consolidate a client's prospect lists
use_cases.description: Combine lists from several research runs while preserving each source and keeping uncertain matches available for review.

use_cases.title: Build a company-level contact summary
use_cases.description: Merge contact exports, group companies by root domain, and compare the number of contacts at each company.

prompt_templates.title: Merge two CSV files locally
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [first CSV] and [second CSV] without enrichment. Keep the source name on each record and put uncertain matches in the review file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a first merge with the standard match rules.

prompt_templates.title: Use stricter matching rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [sheet tabs] using only exact work email or profile URL. Leave name-only matches separate and report rows with conflicting titles. Keep all processing local.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when contacts may have common names.

prompt_templates.title: Review an enrichment plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Deduplicate [lists] locally first. Show the destination, fields, and row count for up to 25 ambiguous contacts. Wait for approval before sending any contact to Leadsets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when approved enrichment may resolve conflicting employers or roles.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a controlled CRM handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [CRM export] and [event list] locally. Produce separate contact, company, and review files, with source labels and conflicts. Reconcile the row counts without writing to the CRM.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reviewers need a complete record before deciding what to import.

output_examples.input: Merge a webinar list and a CRM export without enrichment.
output: The two lists contained 300 rows. The merged list contains 248 people, with 52 duplicate rows merged.
The review file lists 9 uncertain matches kept separate. No contact data was sent to Leadsets.

output_examples.input: Consolidate three prospect lists and enrich up to 12 ambiguous rows after approval.
output: The merge reduced 160 input rows to 130 contact rows across 78 companies.
Leadsets helped resolve 8 of 12 ambiguous rows. The other 4 remain flagged for review.

best_practices: Run a local merge first and approve external enrichment only after reviewing the destination, fields, and proposed row count.
Keep original exports and source labels so you can trace and correct a merge.
Check row totals, conflicts, and unresolved matches before importing or using the merged list.
anti_patterns: Merging two people based on a shared name alone.
Treating unchecked, unknown, or catch-all email addresses as verified.
Combining lists from different clients without authorization.

faq.question: Which input formats can I merge?
faq.answer: Use two or more CSV files, Google Sheets tabs, or CRM exports that your assistant can access.

faq.question: How are duplicates identified?
faq.answer: The default order is exact work email, profile URL, then normalized full name plus company domain. You can change the rules.

faq.question: Does the skill send contacts to Leadsets?
faq.answer: By default, it sends ambiguous rows for enrichment. Ask for a local-only merge to disable that transfer.

faq.question: Does it cost anything to merge lists?
faq.answer: Local matching does not use Leadsets credits. Enrichment uses one record for each match returned, subject to account limits.

faq.question: What happens when titles or employers disagree?
faq.answer: The merge keeps conflicting values and their source labels. Cases that remain uncertain are listed for review.

faq.question: Will it change existing CRM records?
faq.answer: No. The workflow produces a merged list and does not delete or overwrite existing CRM records.
